#  | TTS Communication Tool Docs

> A lightweight Windows desktop text-to-speech application for fast, reliable voice communication in Discord, VRChat, and other voice-enabled applications.

- [TTS Communication Tool](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/index.md): TTS Communication Tool

## Getting Started

- [Installation](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/getting-started/installation.md): Requirement
- [Quickstart](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/getting-started/quickstart.md): Get from a fresh install to speaking your first message in under two minutes.
- [Configuration](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/getting-started/configuration.md): The app stores all settings in a JSON configuration file. Most settings are managed through the Settings window, but understanding the file structure helps with troubleshooting and backup.

## User Guide

- [User Guide Overview](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/user-guide/overview.md): The TTS Communication Tool is designed around a simple, fast workflow. This guide covers every user-facing feature.
- [Features](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/user-guide/features.md): Press a configurable global hotkey (default: Ctrl+Shift+Space) from anywhere to open a dark, always-on-top input overlay. The overlay auto-focuses the text input so you can start typing immediately.
- [TTS Workflow](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/user-guide/tts-workflow.md): This page explains the complete text-to-speech pipeline from keypress to audio output.
- [Voices](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/user-guide/voices.md): The app supports two TTS engines: Kokoro (offline, default) and ElevenLabs (cloud, optional).
- [Audio Output](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/user-guide/audio-output.md): The app plays audio simultaneously to two independent output devices:
- [Settings](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/user-guide/settings.md): The Settings window provides access to all configuration options. Open it by:
- [Keyboard Shortcuts](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/user-guide/shortcuts.md): These hotkeys work from anywhere in Windows, even when other applications are focused.
- [Phrase System](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/user-guide/phrase-system.md): The phrase system lets you save frequently-used messages and trigger them instantly.
- [Text Replacements](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/user-guide/text-replacements.md): Text replacements automatically transform your input text before it's sent to the TTS engine. This is useful for expanding abbreviations, correcting common typos, or substituting words.
- [Themes](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/user-guide/themes.md): The theme system allows complete visual customization of the application.
- [Importing & Exporting](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/user-guide/importing-exporting.md): The app supports importing and exporting data for portability and backup.

## Reference

- [Configuration Files](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/reference/config-files.md): Location: %AppData%\TtsCommunicationTool\config.json
- [File Formats](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/reference/file-formats.md): Each line is a JSON object:
- [Environment Variables](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/reference/environment-variables.md): The app does not use environment variables for configuration. All settings are stored in the JSON config file at %AppData%\TtsCommunicationTool\config.json.

## Developer Guide

- [Architecture](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/developer-guide/architecture.md): The application follows a clean layered MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) architecture with four projects:
- [Project Structure](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/developer-guide/project-structure.md)
- [Data Flow](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/developer-guide/data-flow.md)
- [TTS Engine Integration](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/developer-guide/tts-engine-integration.md): The TTS system uses a router pattern to support multiple engines:
- [Debugging](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/developer-guide/debugging.md): The app has a two-tier logging system:
- [Testing](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/developer-guide/testing.md): The project uses xUnit with Moq for mocking.
- [Adding Features](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/developer-guide/adding-features.md): Create a feature work item — Follow the naming convention FEAT-XXX-description.md in docs/features/

## Troubleshooting

- [Common Issues](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/troubleshooting/common-issues.md): Symptoms: App starts but shows error: "TTS engine failed to initialize"
- [Audio Problems](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/troubleshooting/audio-problems.md): Check Windows volume mixer — ensure the app isn't muted
- [Dependency Problems](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/troubleshooting/dependency-problems.md): Symptoms: "Failed to load runtime" or app won't start
- [Platform Notes](https://finickyspider.github.io/TtsCommunicationTool/troubleshooting/platform-notes.md): This application is Windows-only and will not run on Linux or macOS. It depends on:
